[!cgo] skip

env GOEXPERIMENT=coro
mkdir direct
go tool cgo -objdir=direct main.go
grep '//go:cgo_direct v1 _Cfunc_add_u64 _Cdirect_add_u64 add_u64 mayblock u64,u64 u64 -' direct/_cgo_gotypes.go
! grep 'cgo_direct.*may_callback' direct/_cgo_gotypes.go
go run .
stdout '^42$'

env GOEXPERIMENT=nocoro
mkdir ordinary
go tool cgo -objdir=ordinary main.go
! grep 'cgo_direct' ordinary/_cgo_gotypes.go
go run .
stdout '^42$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/direct

go 1.26

-- main.go --
package main

/*
#include <stdint.h>

#cgo noescape add_u64
#cgo nocallback add_u64

uint64_t add_u64(uint64_t, uint64_t);

static uint64_t may_callback(uint64_t value) {
	return value;
}
*/
import "C"
import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println(C.add_u64(19, 23))
}

-- add.c --
#include <stdint.h>

uint64_t add_u64(uint64_t a, uint64_t b) {
	return a + b;
}
